The original zero-input first-element predicate is weak; bounded full-output probes supplement it.
The opacity barrier receives no Scheme vector, so it does not establish dynamic work retention.
Explicit setup precedes the timer; lazy V8 compilation/tiering during the run and strict support/native sine overhead are included.
